from pip._vendor.packaging.requirements import Requirement

from pip._vendor.packaging.tags import sys_tags
from pip._vendor.packaging.utils import canonicalize_name, parse_wheel_filename
from pip._vendor.packaging.version import Version
MiB=1048576
run=Path(sys.argv[1])
deadline=time.monotonic()+70
assert (platform.python_version(),sys.implementation.name,os.getuid(),platform.machine(),sys.platform)==("3.14.4","cpython",1000,"x86_64","linux")
report=Path("docs/evidence/task-12/resolver-first-20261025/report.json").read_bytes()

items=json.loads(report)["install"]

lock=Path("detect/sigma/requirements.lock").read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(lock).hexdigest()=="af3de7ebdd63284a206235aaf1cc2a9cf0076d0ea3d395874cc5f5a070c8b752"
(run/"offline.lock").write_bytes(lock)
class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
 def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):
  raise ValueError("redirect")
opener=urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect)
def fetch(url,path,limit):
 assert time.monotonic()<deadline
 req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={"Accept-Encoding":"identity"})
 count=0
 with opener.open(req,timeout=min(8,deadline-time.monotonic())) as response, path.open("xb") as output:
  assert response.status==200
  while count<limit:
   assert time.monotonic()<deadline
   block=response.read(min(65536,limit-count))
   if not block:
    break
   output.write(block); count+=len(block)
  assert not response.read(1), "oversize; prefix retained"
 return count
supported=set(sys_tags())
selected=[]
metadata_total=0
wheel_total=0
versions={}
for item in items:
 m=item["metadata"]; name=canonicalize_name(m["name"]); version=Version(m["version"])
 assert name not in versions and item["is_yanked"] is False
 versions[name]=version
 url=item["download_info"]["url"]; parsed=urllib.parse.urlsplit(url)
 assert parsed.scheme=="https" and parsed.netloc=="files.pythonhosted.org" and not parsed.query and not parsed.fragment
 filename=parsed.path.rsplit("/",1)[-1]
 wn,wv,_,tags=parse_wheel_filename(filename)
 assert canonicalize_name(wn)==name and wv==version and supported.intersection(tags)
 digest=item["download_info"]["archive_info"]["hashes"]["sha256"]
 api="https://pypi.org/pypi/"+urllib.parse.quote(name,safe="")+"/"+urllib.parse.quote(str(version),safe="")+"/json"

 size=fetch(api,path,min(2*MiB,16*MiB-metadata_total))
 metadata_total+=size
 data=json.loads(path.read_bytes())
 assert canonicalize_name(data["info"]["name"])==name and Version(data["info"]["version"])==version
 matches=[u for u in data["urls"] if u["filename"]==filename and u["url"]==url]
 assert len(matches)==1
 u=matches[0]
 assert u["packagetype"]=="bdist_wheel" and u["yanked"] is False and u["digests"]["sha256"]==digest
 exact=u["size"]
 assert type(exact) is int and 0<exact<=16*MiB
 for requirement in (data["info"].get("requires_python"),u.get("requires_python"),m.get("requires_python")):
  if requirement: assert SpecifierSet(requirement).contains(Version("3.14.4"),prereleases=True)
 wheel_total+=exact
 assert metadata_total<=16*MiB and wheel_total<=16*MiB
 selected.append({"name":name,"version":str(version),"filename":filename,"url":url,"sha256":digest,"bytes":exact,"requires_dist":m.get("requires_dist",[])})
for entry in selected:
 for text in entry["requires_dist"]:
  req=Requirement(text)
  if req.marker is None or req.marker.evaluate({"extra":""}):
   name=canonicalize_name(req.name)
   assert name in versions and req.specifier.contains(versions[name],prereleases=True)
unzipped=0
expanded_allocated=0
member_count=0
for entry in selected:
 path=run/"wheels"/entry["filename"]
 size=fetch(entry["url"],path,entry["bytes"])
 assert size==entry["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==entry["sha256"]
 metadata=[]
 entry_allocated=0
 entry_dirs=set()
 with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as archive:
  seen=set()
  for info in archive.infolist():
   member_count+=1
   assert member_count<=8192
   value=info.filename; parts=PurePosixPath(value).parts
   assert value and len(value.encode())<=1024 and not value.startswith("/") and "\\" not in value
   assert parts and all(p not in ("",".","..") and ":" not in p for p in parts)
   assert parts not in seen; seen.add(parts)
   mode=stat.S_IFMT(info.external_attr>>16)
   assert mode in (0,stat.S_IFREG,stat.S_IFDIR) and not (info.flag_bits&1)
   assert 0<=info.file_size<=16*MiB
   if info.is_dir(): entry_dirs.add(parts)
   else: entry_allocated+=((info.file_size+4095)//4096)*4096
   entry_dirs.update(parts[:depth] for depth in range(1,len(parts)))
   unzipped+=info.file_size
   assert unzipped<=64*MiB
   actual=0
   with archive.open(info) as source:
    while True:
     block=source.read(65536)
     if not block: break
     actual+=len(block)
     assert actual<=info.file_size
   assert actual==info.file_size
   if len(parts)==2 and parts[0].endswith(".dist-info") and parts[1]=="METADATA":
    metadata.append(email.message_from_bytes(archive.read(info)))
 expanded_allocated+=entry_allocated+4096*(len(entry_dirs)+1)
 assert len(metadata)==1
 m=metadata[0]
 assert canonicalize_name(m["Name"])==entry["name"] and Version(m["Version"])==Version(entry["version"])
 if m.get("Requires-Python"):
  assert SpecifierSet(m["Requires-Python"]).contains(Version("3.14.4"),prereleases=True)
 assert sorted(str(Requirement(x)) for x in m.get_all("Requires-Dist",[]))==sorted(str(Requirement(x)) for x in entry["requires_dist"])
# Each wheel parent set is counted separately, conservatively retaining overlaps.
# Peak: wheels+metadata+two 4KiB-rounded trees+tmp16/source8MiB.
peak=wheel_total+metadata_total+2*expanded_allocated+24*MiB
assert peak<=134217728
record={"packages":selected,"metadata_bytes":metadata_total,"wheel_bytes":wheel_total,"expanded_bytes":unzipped,"expanded_allocated_bytes":expanded_allocated,"peak_bytes":peak}
raw=(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+"\n").encode()
assert len(raw)<=2*MiB
(run/"selected.json").write_bytes(raw)
print(metadata_total,wheel_total,unzipped,expanded_allocated,peak)
